node: Housing repair, remodel, rental-maintenance, and affordability-linked building products
summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for housing repair/remodel, rental-maintenance, HVAC replacement, and affordability-linked building products. The two-lane funnel keeps Watsco as a reference leader for HVAC/R distribution while prioritizing underfollowed small/mid-cap exposure through Hillman Solutions, Patrick Industries, and Legacy Housing. The strongest direct repair/remodel fit is Hillman, whose filings state its products are primarily used by DIYers and small contractors for repair, maintenance, and remodel projects. Patrick and Legacy are more affordability/manufactured-housing exposed, while Watsco is a larger-cap HVAC replacement/distribution anchor rather than an obscure discovery name.
